The shared target of these compounds at the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase level suggests a common pathway or mechanism of action, potentially involving kinase activation or inhibition. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same kinase implies that the interaction may be biologically significant and not merely a coincidence. The integrated evidence supports a mechanism where Npc115753 may modulate the activity of these kinases, which in turn influence VMRC-LCP. The observed scores and the shared target suggest a plausible, though not yet fully characterized, relationship between Npc115753 and VMRC-LCP, likely involving a direct or indirect interaction at the kinase level.
